test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who took charge as the Chief Election Commissioner of India on 19 February 2025, under the new provisions of the 2023 appointment act?
solution: The correct answer is __**Gyanesh Kumar**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Gyanesh Kumar** took charge as the **Chief Election Commissioner (CEC)** of India on **19 February 2025**. • His appointment and subsequent elevation to the top post were conducted under the new provisions of **The Chief Election Commissioner and other Election Commissioners (Appointment, Conditions of Service and Term of Office) Act, 2023**. • He succeeded **Rajiv Kumar**, who demitted the office of **Chief Election Commissioner** on **18 February 2025** after the completion of his tenure. • Prior to becoming the **CEC**, **Gyanesh Kumar** had been serving as an **Election Commissioner** since **March 2024**. • He is a retired **1988-batch Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer** of the **Kerala cadre** and has previously served as the **Secretary** in the **Ministry of Cooperation** and the **Ministry of Utpal Kumar Singh**.
